name: Hero artwork becomes a type stage
description: Reuse one artwork system across acquisition and brand variants. Builds an editable 12-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: Original artwork can establish a recognizable visual world before the message.

props.title: Hero artwork becomes a type stage

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 12 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: Your hero artwork fills the screen, then moves away and leaves a quiet stage.

props.text: A related, calmer image. It stays as the stage for your message.

props.label: Opening line
props.hint: Short. The artwork does most of the work.

props.subtitle: One headline on the quiet stage, then a small offer.
Your brand and the call to action, with a small art motif.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

value.title: Hero artwork becomes a type stage
value.objective: Reuse one artwork system across acquisition and brand variants.
value.direction: The visual world persists while foreground detail gives way to readable typography.
beats: 0–2.5 s: Hero art fills a composed region of the canvas. Shows Brand color, Hero artwork, Opening line.
2.5–4.5 s: Hero foreground exits or crops away; related secondary field remains. Shows Brand color, Hero artwork, Background artwork.
4.5–7.5 s: One headline occupies the newly quiet stage. Shows Brand color, Background artwork, Headline.
7.5–9.5 s: Small offer or next-step statement joins the headline. Shows Brand color, Background artwork, Offer or benefit.
9.5–12 s: Readable brand and CTA with a small art motif. Shows Brand color, Background artwork, Logo, Call to action.

images.label: Hero artwork
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Hero art fills a composed region of the canvas. | Hero foreground exits or crops away; related secondary field remains.

images.label: Background artwork
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Hero foreground exits or crops away; related secondary field remains. | One headline occupies the newly quiet stage. | Small offer or next-step statement joins the headline. | Readable brand and CTA with a small art motif.

images.label: Logo
images.guidance: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: Readable brand and CTA with a small art motif.
